channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Lonzo Ball | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Lonzo Ball from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Koby Altman on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Statement from Koby Altman:

“Lonzo Ball was the consummate professional during his time with the Cavaliers, and we’re grateful for his hard work and team-first mentality. We wish him nothing but the best moving forward.”

Koby Altman on Lonzo Ball, Feb 5, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Koby Altman on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
“We are very excited about this opportunity to acquire someone with the skillset and versatility that Lonzo Ball brings to this team,”

Koby Altman on Lonzo Ball, Jul 6, 2025. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Josh Hart on LeBron James, Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Hart recalled admiring then-Los Angeles Lakers teammates LeBron James and Lonzo Ball do it in 2018.

“I was in L.A. when [James and Ball] did it, and that sounded really dope,”

Josh Hart on LeBron James, Lonzo Ball, Mar 26, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Chicago Bulls executive Arturas Karnišovas on extending Lonzo Ball:

“The complexity of challenges that Zo faced more than three years ago was truly unprecedented. It wasn’t just his injury but also the complicated rehabilitation plan that followed, which lacked any template for an NBA player. Along with an outstanding team of doctors, trainers and medical staff, Zo embraced adversity and exemplified resilience. His diligence to do what was necessary and his commitment to himself and this team truly speaks to his character. He elevates those around him with his high basketball IQ, relentless defense and hustle, and his unselfish playmaking. We are thrilled to have him back and for him to be a part of our future.”

Arturas Karnisovas on Lonzo Ball, Feb 14, 2025. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
guard Zach LaVine said of life without Williams.

“Some games Zo (Lonzo Ball) will come in and play the four or I’ll play the four and it’s like, ‘OK, we’ve got to get a stop or outscore them.’ One of the two.”

Zach LaVine on Lonzo Ball, Dec 12, 2024. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Zach LaVine on Lonzo Ball return:

“It was emotional in a happy way. We made sure we got him the game ball because that’s a big moment. Nobody has come back from what he’s coming back from.”

Zach LaVine on Lonzo Ball, Oct 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Darnell Mayberry:DeRozan on Ball:

“More so than anything, just as a friend (I’m) just worried about him. I could care less about anything to do with the team. Just his mental well-being and hoping he’s got all the positive backing that he needs to get through whatever he needs to get through.”

DeMar DeRozan on Lonzo Ball, Mar 17, 2023. Source: Twitter @DarnellMayberry.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Arturas Karnisovas on long-term concern for Lonzo Ball's knee:

“I'll be positive, because we missed him greatly this year... We're going to try to figure it out this summer.”

Arturas Karnisovas on Lonzo Ball, Apr 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Lonzo Ball, Kevin Porter
item.description:
Ball had knocked down a 3-pointer, but was whistled for an offensive foul on the play — presumably for initiating contact with the contesting defender, Kevin Porter Jr., after or in the process of releasing the ball.

“I was told he (Ball) shot it, he came down and fell down and kind of grabbed the guy (Porter Jr.),”

Billy Donovan on Lonzo Ball, Kevin Porter, Nov 25, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Kelly Oubre, Lonzo Ball
item.description:
He says the Warriors turned down a Lonzo Ball trade from the New Orleans Pelicans centered around Oubre.

“This is an interesting one because I got some word from behind the scenes there.... I have it on good authority they had on offer actually for Lonzo Ball and I think a throw-in pick for Oubre and the Warriors turned it down, funnily enough,”

Andrew Bogut on Kelly Oubre, Lonzo Ball, Apr 6, 2021. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Isaiah Thomas on Lonzo Ball, a LAL teammate in 2017-18:

“You can just tell the confidence is on another level. He’s not thinking twice about his jump shot. Obviously his jumper is looking a lot better than it did when he first came into the league. Last game was amazing.”

Isaiah Thomas on Lonzo Ball, Apr 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Eric Bledsoe on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Eric Bledsoe on teaming up with Lonzo Ball:

“I’m excited. It’s an adjustment for me, but he's a great, talented player. He knows how to play on or off the ball. He doesn’t have to go out and score 30 points every night. He has to do what he does to make an impact on the game.”

Eric Bledsoe on Lonzo Ball, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Kira Lewis on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Will Guillory:Kira Lewis on playing with Lonzo Ball:

“I think it’s going to be a good combination with me and Lonzo.”

Kira Lewis on Lonzo Ball, Nov 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Brandon Ingram on Lonzo Ball's improvement as a shooter:

“It’s a beautiful thing to see. He’s put in the work. He goes to the gym, even when I say I’m tired and I’m taking days off. He’s there all the time. He’s falling in love with the game of basketball. I like what he’s doing”

Brandon Ingram on Lonzo Ball, Mar 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Zion Williamson on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Pelicans’ Zion Williamson on his half-court lob connections w/ Lonzo Ball:

“Even though they’re from so far away, he just puts it on a spot like he’s throwing a close lob from the elbow. He puts in on a perfect spot and I’m just able to get it.”

Zion Williamson on Lonzo Ball, Mar 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Jrue Holiday on Lonzo Ball's play and how Ball's presence has benefited Holiday on defensive end, taking on tough assignments:

“It’s fun. I like to see other people succeed. Seeing Zo do what he does, he looks pretty happy out there playing, he looks healthy. It’s good for me.”

Jrue Holiday on Lonzo Ball, Mar 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Alvin Gentry on Lonzo Ball:

“I’ve been a fan of Zo since he came in the league. I just think playing in a system like we’ve got was going to enhance his game, and give him the opportunity to be who he really is.”

Alvin Gentry on Lonzo Ball, Feb 29, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Brandon Ingram on Lonzo Ball defense (4 stl, 2 blk vs. Cle):

“It goes unnoticed sometimes, because he does that night in and night out. He’s always anticipating a pass, always in the right spot. His on-ball defense is really, really good. That’s something he’s done every night.”

Brandon Ingram on Lonzo Ball, Feb 29, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: JJ Redick on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:JJ Redick on Lonzo Ball:

“I think he's been fantastic over the last couple weeks. He’s really raised his level of play. A lot of that obviously is shooting the ball well, but he’s also pushing and running downhill, in transition and the halfcourt. That’s been really key for us.”

JJ Redick on Lonzo Ball, Jan 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Jrue Holiday on anticipation to see what Lonzo Ball can do for #Pelicans:

“We know how well he passes, how fast he is, his vision is awesome. I know we’ll be able to run the (break). We have high-fliers, as we saw with the rookies in summer league. It’s going to be a good time.”

Jrue Holiday on Lonzo Ball, Oct 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Zion Williamson on Brandon Ingram, Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Ben Golliver:Zion Williamson on Lonzo Ball & Brandon Ingram:

“Lonzo is a great PG, very old school and I respect that. Brandon is a bucket-getter, he can give you 25 or 30 a night.”

Zion Williamson on Brandon Ingram, Lonzo Ball, Jun 19, 2019. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Harrison Gaines on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
“Lonzo Ball was the first client to sign with me. He has been nothing short of phenomenal and is one of the bright young NBA Stars. I thank him and his family for giving me an opportunity,”

Harrison Gaines on Lonzo Ball, Apr 5, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Javale McGee on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Kyle Goon:McGee on Lonzo Ball:

“I feel like Zo’s been really stepping up. Damn near had a triple-double. He had one and then they took it away. I don’t know how you do that. They don’t ever bring my blocks back when I get goaltends, so why would they take away his rebounds?”

Javale McGee on Lonzo Ball, Dec 30, 2018. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on LeBron James, Josh Hart, Lonzo Ball
item.description:
“The way (LeBron) is able to make shots and take over a game, it gives you confidence that you have a threat. “Then there’s (Kyle) Kuzma, Josh Hart is a hell of a player, the right kind of player. Lonzo Ball is the kind of player who doesn’t need to score to have a great game. Experience is a key for them and as the season comes on they will get there.”

Dwyane Wade on LeBron James, Josh Hart, Lonzo Ball, Dec 11, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Magic Johnson on LeBron James, Rajon Rondo, Brandon Ingram, Lonzo Ball, Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Johnson told SiriusXM NBA Radio.

“We got a lot of ballhandlers so we feel we won't overuse him in terms of his ballhandling and also every play has to run through him. I think we got proven scorers -- Kyle Kuzma, Brandon Ingram ... and then when you have two point guards like Ball and Rondo, we don't have to have LeBron having the ball in his hands all the time.”

Magic Johnson on LeBron James, Rajon Rondo, Brandon Ingram, Lonzo Ball, Kyle Kuzma, Nov 29, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Kyle Kuzma on Lonzo Ball's conditioning tonight:

“.I don’t know how he does it. He didn’t do nothing all summer, practiced for the first time last week or whatever. He was running up and down, great physical shape, so I think he did great for the most part.”

Kyle Kuzma on Lonzo Ball, Oct 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Eddie House, Stephon Marbury, Sam Cassell, Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Bob Garcia:Rajon Rondo on if he's going to mentor Lonzo Ball:

“Yeah that's obviously. My rookie year my guys were Sam Cassell, Stephon Marbury, and Eddie House. I didn't look at this guys as competition.”

Rajon Rondo on Eddie House, Stephon Marbury, Sam Cassell, Lonzo Ball, Sep 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @bgarciaivsports.

item.title: Rick Fox on Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Rick Fox on if Lonzo Ball is the real deal:

“I've seen a year and I like all that is there in the talent department, but I haven't seen enough.”

Rick Fox on Lonzo Ball, Sep 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Michael Cooper on Brandon Ingram, Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Michael Cooper:

“Brandon Ingram is a player that is going to stand out in my mind. He’s going to be a player that they’ll always be proud to have. I think Lonzo Ball as he learns his game and understands it, he’s going to be pretty good in the future too.”

Michael Cooper on Brandon Ingram, Lonzo Ball, Aug 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Michael Cooper on Magic Johnson, Lonzo Ball, Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Michael Cooper on Lonzo Ball & Kyle Kuzma:

“Lonzo Ball has shown that he’s kind of like a Magic Johnson-type of player. He’s the type of player that makes other players around him better. I think Kyle Kuzma has shown that he can shoot the ball with some of the best.”

Michael Cooper on Magic Johnson, Lonzo Ball, Kyle Kuzma, Aug 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.
